title: A mail arrives
summary: A booking confirmation lands in iCloud Mail. The attention pass judges it work, and a short-lived work thread puts the stay on your calendar, notices check-in closes before you land, drafts a note in your voice into Drafts and posts one line into the conversation. Nothing is sent.

input.body: Hi! We land at 22:10 on the 20th, so we'll reach you around 23:00, after reception closes. Could you leave the keys for us, or tell us how late check-in works? Thanks, Divy
